sections.heading: How to Obtain a CDSCO Manufacturing License in India?
paragraphs: In India, if one intends to manufacture drugs, cosmetics, or medical devices, it is imperative to have a CDSCO manufacturing license. Not only is it a legal requirement but also a prerequisite for compliance with safety and credibility in the market. This information from Services Plus will guide you through the detailed process of acquiring a CDSCO license. It will include insights into CDSCO online registration in India, CDSCO import license registration, and other broad requirements regarding drug license registration.

According to the Drugs and Cosmetics Act of 1940, the manufacturing license is granted by the Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO). With this license, companies can legally manufacture drug license registration, cosmetics, or medical devices in India. CDSCO is a national regulatory authority under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. Thus, ensure this authority's products meet the prescribed safety, efficacy, and quality standards.
It works under the Directorate General of Health Services under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare. The organization is responsible for:
Approval of new drugs and clinical trials
Laying down standards for drugs and cosmetics
Controlling the quality of imported drugs
Coordinating with state drug control organizations
